questions.stem: A 40-year-old man presents to your clinic with a past medical history of muscle weakness and hypokalemia. There is no family history of muscle weakness with hypokalemia. Physical exam is significant for a blood pressure of 150/90, heart rate of 110 beats per minute, and respiratory rate of 18 breaths per minute. The patient also has an enlarged thyroid and a 10-pound unintended weight loss this month. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
